player_prompt.intro:
Inwe ni Nyakwamba {player_id}. Inwe osiki FifteenPuzzle.
Mudi mar tich nyalo ni koro tiles mar nambari mosekende kendo kwakende, e pacho mara e chini-kulia.
Iri nawi koro, inwe iwezo koro tile mosekende e pacho mara (morocho __) kwa kutumia komandi moja e kati:
- 'up': Koro tile piny mara e pacho mara juu.
- 'down': Koro tile juu mara e pacho mara piny.
- 'left': Koro tile e kulia mara e pacho mara kushoto.
- 'right': Koro tile e kushoto mara e pacho mara kulia.
Iri nawi koro, inwe iwezo koro komandi (kama, 'up', 'down', 'left', kendo 'right') e mabano, kama [up].
Mipangilio ya sasa ya papani inakonywa chini. Tumia habari hii kutatua puzzle.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yo ma ok owinjore mar tugo. Jalo {player_id} ne ok odwoko gi yo mowinjore e kind brackets mag kare ariyo.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Ok nyalre. Olembego ok nyal yiengni e yo mowachono.

outcome.win: Wagoyo erokamano! Jalo {player_id} oseloso maber oboke mar 15.
outcome.turn_limit: Giko mar ng'wech osechopo. Ngero otieko {percent} pasent mag puzzle
